name: Tiling UVs
explanation_long: Imports a 3D/CAD model and assigns tiling UVs. These UVs are non-paintable, but great for material assignment workflows. UVs are created through triplanar mapping.
explanation: Imports a 3D/CAD model and assigns tiling UVs. These UVs are non-paintable, but great for material assignment workflows. UVs are created through triplanar mapping.

exposed_options.name: Convert Z-Up to Y-Up
exposed_options.description: Turns rotation to z-axis pointing upwards on/off. Helpful if origin axis system is Z-Up and target system is Y-Up.

exposed_options.name: CAD Sewing Tolerance
exposed_options.description: Helps with sewing CAD surface patches before conversion into triangles (tessellation). By default it is set to 0.05 mm, meaning if two surfaces have a gap greater than 0.05mm, they will not be sewed.

exposed_options.name: Tiling UV Scale
exposed_options.description: Scale factor for the tiling UVs. By default, the scale is 1.0 meaning the unwrapped tiles correspond to the respective scale of the 3D surfaces in meters.

exposed_options.name: Fix Winding Order
exposed_options.description: Automatically fix the winding order of parts on import.

exposed_options.name: Remove Occluded Parts
exposed_options.description: Removes invisible (occluded) parts from the 3D model on import.

exposed_options.name: Simplify with UVs
exposed_options.description: Simplify mesh to a certain amount of faces, while preserving UVs.
